purpose: Define the strict JSON payload format used by cynic-hermes-bridge to inject tasks into the Hermes Agent via its local API Gateway (POST /v1/chat/completions).
contract_rules: The payload MUST conform to the OpenAI Chat Completion API format.
The 'messages' array MUST start with a 'system' role that strictly enforces the Monopoly of MCP (disabling native tools) and forces the use of the cynic_observe tool at the end.
The 'messages' array MUST contain a 'user' role injecting the exact payload from the CYNIC Mempool.
The 'tools' array MUST declare the MCP server capabilities if the Hermes API requires explicit tool declaration, or rely on Hermes native config.yaml dynamic tool discovery.
If the task requires editing files, 'tool_choice' MAY explicitly require 'cynic_observe' to enforce the Bloodstream output contract.

messages_structure.content: Strict organism instructions (Castration, Monopoly of MCP, Hybrid Inference rules)

messages.content: You are a cognitive brain for CYNIC. You have no physical hands. You MUST use the cynic-mcp tool to read/write files. When done, you MUST call cynic_observe.
